text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: We did it, Trainer. —It is our victory.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"I was thinking only of winning right to 
the very end. Just fixing my eyes intently 
on the finish line—"
choice_data_list: You were really focused, weren't you

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Strangely enough, time felt like... 
it was slowing down. I get this feeling 
sometimes. And then—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Things usually go well at times like 
this. And then the cheers pull me right 
back to reality..."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: This feeling is nice, isn't it...?
choice_data_list:
Let's not get complacent and keep building 
up our progress.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: This feeling is nice, isn't it...?
choice_data_list:
Let's not get complacent and keep building 
up our progress.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I worked up a good sweat. This sense 
of fulfillment...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I will savor this joy— and use it as 
motivation for my next race.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Exactly. It's always a 
lapse in vigilance that leads to ruin.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Let us stack them stone by stone. Until 
the day we build an impregnable fortress 
wall.
